subject: Convert circle-warning rotation degrees through Original sword radians
description: Old schema-12 representative `parity-random-save-replays-60s-15x/traces/Savegame_SuN1Sh1nE/Profile_004/Savegame_024/replay-004-session-0001.jsonl.zst` reached an RNG-cardinality frontier during Original frame 911 on the frozen Task378-descendant runner: Original consumed one macro draw, three repeated strike-proposal draws, and five repeated swordfight-evaluation draws, while Rust consumed `MacroRand`, only one `SwordStrikeSelection`, and three `MeleeNonMutualGate` draws. The WaitingSword ownership diagnostic identified Rust's later evaluation owners as Soldiers 100, 103, and 112; full engine state showed moving-with-sword Soldiers 110 and 111 were the two omitted warned defenders, and Original had already selected ParrySword for Soldier110 by frame 912 while Rust retained WalkingWithSword. Original `GetPossibleVictimsOfCircleSwordStrike(..., true)` extends the warning radius for a walking-with-sword human with `(UWORD)(10 + relative_sector * 5 * PI / (8 * GetStrikeRotationAngle(strike)))` (`original-code/RHelementactorhuman.cpp:10598-10647`). `RHSword::GetStrikeRotationAngle` first converts the CPF profile's degree-valued rotation through double intermediates to a narrowed `FLOAT` radians value (`original-code/RHSword.cpp:283-289`). Rust instead divided by the raw profile degrees, making nearly the entire relative-sector extension disappear and excluding Soldiers110/111. Commit `4d5e481ef784b158d00bf8cd8be99b0e24598e86` adds the source-exact degree-to-radian conversion and narrows the complete extension to `u16` before adding it to the maximal distance. The focused moving-versus-waiting collector regression is non-vacuous and passes 1/1; independent source reviews approve the formula, narrowing, vector direction, and MovingSword predicate. Authoritative optimized runner SHA-256 `226d83c5deac0a89007d5fc1661cd5bb188d7d4c4908076a525486650679b6de` matches both task-36 schema-14 controls through exact EOF: Cyrdach Profile_156 Savegame_001 replay-009 and Nescafe Profile_001 Savegame_001 replay-009. The representative is explicitly UNOBSERVABLE on the current integration and no f911 clearance or downstream advance is claimed: the same runner stops first at an independent Original-frame-752 RNG over-consumption (`SwordDamageProtection` twice plus `MeleeProvoke` after the six Original draws). The committed scope is exactly `crates/robin_engine/src/engine/melee/mod.rs`; formatting and scoped diff checks pass.
